customer_question: We can't log into the Bluetooth SIG account using the username and password we provided in the proxy registration confirmation form - it says 'Invalid username or password'. Also, the Qualification Fee Receipt Number is tied to a different account than the one we want to use for registration - what do we do?
question_variants: Why can't Allion log in with the SIG account credentials we provided?
The employee who set up our SIG account has left the company and the account seems inactive - how do we recover access or create a new account?
How do we transfer the Qualification Fee Receipt Number to a new SIG account so registration can proceed?
actual_issue: Allion attempted to log into the customer's Bluetooth SIG account using the username/password provided in the proxy registration confirmation form but received 'Invalid username or password'. Allion explained that the SIG member-page login credentials are required for product registration too, and must be the same account used to obtain the Qualification Fee remittance Invoice. After investigation, the customer discovered that the account belonged to a since-departed employee and had been deactivated; using a departed employee's ID would cause complications, so the customer created a new account and sent a revised proxy registration confirmation form with the new credentials. Allion then found that the Qualification Fee 'Receipt Number' (proof of SIG's receipt of funds) was tied to the account of the person who had obtained the Invoice (the old/different account), not the new account, and so could not be used directly from the new account. Allion performed a 'Transfer Request' operation to move the Receipt Number's association to the new account, and instructed the customer to accept the resulting SIG notification email (sent to the new account's associated email) via its 'Accept' link. The customer confirmed approval of the Transfer Request, after which Allion confirmed the Receipt Number had been successfully transferred to the new account and proceeded with registration using a temporary project under Allion's own account to pre-validate the referenced QDIDs and error-avoidance steps, completing the registration that same day.
plain_english_explanation: Bluetooth SIG product registration requires logging in with the same account credentials used to obtain the Qualification Fee payment Invoice - this is the 'member account' tied to the company's SIG membership, not just any company employee's login. If that account was originally set up by an employee who has since left the company, the account may become inactive or its credentials may no longer work, causing 'Invalid username or password' errors during proxy registration. The fix is for the customer to create a new account (or recover access via SIG's 'Get Username' / password-reset flows). However, because the Qualification Fee Receipt Number (the proof-of-payment reference needed to perform registration) is tied to whichever account originally obtained the Invoice, switching to a new account requires a 'Transfer Request' operation - SIG sends a notification email to the new account's associated email address, and the account holder must click 'Accept' (or a similar consent action) to move the Receipt Number's association to the new account before registration can proceed.
consultant_answer: Thank you for sending the proxy registration confirmation form. We tried to log in but got 'Invalid username or password'. The SIG member-page login credentials are also required for product registration, and must be the same account that obtained the registration-fee remittance Invoice. Please re-check and let us know. Later: Thank you for your various responses. We checked the 'Receipt Number' (Qualification Fee receipt ID) from the new account you provided before proxy registration, and found it is assigned to the Invoice-obtaining account, so it can't be used directly from the new account as-is. We therefore performed a 'Transfer Request' operation: an email from SIG with a 'Transfer Request' notification will arrive at the email linked to the original account; please click 'Accept' (or a similar consent action) via the URL in that email. We've since confirmed the Receipt Number has been transferred to the new account.
decision_logic: If proxy-registration login fails with 'Invalid username or password', verify whether the provided account is the same one used to obtain the Qualification Fee Invoice and whether that account is still active (e.g., not tied to a departed employee). If the account is inactive or the customer creates a new account, check whether the Qualification Fee Receipt Number is tied to a different (old) account; if so, perform a SIG 'Transfer Request' to move the Receipt Number's association to the new account, and have the customer 'Accept' the resulting SIG notification email before proceeding with registration.
final_recommendation: When proxy-registration login fails, confirm the credentials match the account that obtained the Qualification Fee Invoice and that the account is active; if the customer must switch to a new account, use SIG's 'Transfer Request' operation to move the Receipt Number to the new account and have the customer accept the SIG notification email before performing registration.
risk_if_done_wrong: Without resolving account/credential mismatches and transferring the Receipt Number to the correct account, proxy registration cannot proceed - SIG won't accept registration without valid login credentials matching the account associated with confirmed fee receipt, potentially delaying the registration past the customer's intended publication/launch date.
